name: Research
description: Finding out about a topic: sources, comparison, a written conclusion.
note: This is a research project. Separate what the sources say from your own inference, name the source of every factual claim, say when a claim is uncertain or could not be checked, and finish with a short conclusion and open questions.
details: Finding out about a topic and writing down what is known. The agent separates what the sources say from its own inference, names the source of every factual claim, says when something is uncertain, and does not invent references. Your Library, the Shelf and PDF text extraction are the sources it can use.
examples: Compare three databases for a small business, with sources
What do these five papers agree and disagree on?
Fact-check a claim and say how sure each source is
Reading notes filed in the Library as you go

tools.why: pages of a PDF as images, for figures and tables
subtitles and metadata of talks you may use

starter.content:
# The question

What exactly do I want to know, and why?

What would count as an answer:

What I already believe (so I can check it):

# Sources

| Source | Author / date | What it says | How far I trust it, and why |
|---|---|---|---|

# Research log

Date, what I searched or read, what I found, what to do next.
